text:
customer-eng: hey — after the cert rotate earlier today, a bunch of users hit 403 at our SSO callback. Only seems to happen when requests come via our CDN domain (cdn.prod.example.com). IdP logs show 'InvalidRecipient'. Any ideas?

sam-support: sorry about that, we'll triage. can you paste the IdP error/log snippet and the SP (our) ACS URL you have configured? also: are you seeing this for all users or a subset?

customer-eng: single user repro so far but now a few more. our ACS is https://app.example.com/sso/callback?env=prod . here's the IdP log: `InvalidRecipient: expected https://app.example.com/sso/acs but got https://app.example.com/sso/callback` — the app.yml has callback as configured.

lia-idp: fyi we rolled the signing certs at 08:12 and published metadata at https://idp.customer-corp.com/metadata.xml — we did add an extra KeyDescriptor entry for the new key, old one still there for rollover. nothing else intentional.

oscar-sre: this looks like a rewrite issue on the CDN edge — we have a rule that rewrites `/sso/callback` -> `/sso/acs` for legacy reasons and, annoyingly, drops the querystring for POSTs unless explicitly preserved. dropping the querystring can make the SP see a different recipient in the SAML assertion validation flow.

sam-support: interesting. so the assertion's Recipient/value is the original request URL (with ?env=prod) but after rewrite the service receives a different path (without env). that would trigger InvalidRecipient. can you try hitting the origin directly (bypass CDN) or temporarily remove the query param?

customer-eng: tried bypassing CDN (direct to origin) and login works. removing ?env=prod from ACS in app config also works for a single user. but we can't change ACS across all customers quickly.

ioscar-sre: short-term fix: we'll change the edge rule to preserve querystring on POST rewrites. long-term we should canonicalize the ACS in SP config to a single expected value and have the IdP accept both recipient variants (or avoid query params entirely).

lia-idp: on the cert side — rotating keys can surface other verification edgecases. if the SP only validates against one KeyInfo entry positionally that could break. recommend explicitly setting use="signing" on the KeyDescriptor for the new key and keeping both keys until everyone picks up the rotation.

sam-support: TL;DR plan: (1) oscar will update CDN rule to preserve querystrings on POSTs (hotfix), (2) lia will add use="signing" to metadata entry and confirm ordering, (3) customer-eng will plan to move ACS to canonical URL without query params in next deploy. I'll keep monitoring.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: edge-preserve-querystring-hotfix -> env=production in 15m (rollout 10%).

customer-eng: thanks — after edge hotfix i can confirm logins for the repro user succeed again :thumbsup:

oscar-sre: pushed config, monitoring metrics. seeing drop in InvalidRecipient errors.

lia-idp: updated metadata with explicit use attributes and re-published. sharing URL: https://idp.customer-corp.com/metadata-v2.xml

sam-support: closing loop — tracking follow-ups: update SP ACS to canonical URL (customer-eng), keep old key for one week (lia-idp), and edge rule change will be promoted to 100% in 1h if no regressions (oscar-sre). thanks everyone :rocket:
